visual_observations: Across all producer-emitted contact sheets, the blue Type-3 fluid remains a coherent wedge over the grey bed profile and the orange moving paddle remains identifiable; no blank, truncated, or globally exploded frame was observed.
The nine keyframes at frames 0,100,200,300,400,500,600,700,800 show a weak non-breaking disturbance with small local shoreline/free-surface changes and later return toward the initial wedge.

A few sparse blue points at the downstream shoreline are visible in the overview/contact views; they are a disclosed display limitation and do not form an obvious bulk spray, wall breach, or severe bed-through failure.
The visual record supports a weak-wave first-stage decision only. It does not prove strict container preservation, exact free-surface transport, numerical precision, or a large runup event.
